ItemID: 1; Title: SAMSUNG Electronics 870 EVO 2TB 2.5 Inch SATA III Internal SSD (MZ-77E2T0B/AM); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My storage history centers on external drives and readers; I have no current internal-drive upgrade planned.
ItemID: 2; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently picked up a fourth-generation Dot, so this older model offers little reason to buy.
ItemID: 3; Title: Fire TV Stick (3rd Gen) with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) + Star Wars The Mandalorian remote cover (Grogu Green); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle already covers this need, and the themed cover adds little appeal.
ItemID: 4; Title: Blink Whole Home Bundle | Video Doorbell System, Outdoor camera, and Mini camera | HD video, motion detection, Works with Alexa; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Alexa-compatible security interests me, but I would start with a doorbell before committing to several cameras.
ItemID: 5; Title: SAMSUNG EVO Select Micro SD-Memory-Card + Adapter, 512GB microSDXC 130MB/s Full HD & 4K UHD, UHS-I, U3, A2, V30, Expanded Storage for Android Smartphones, Tablets, Nintendo-Switch (MB-ME512KA/AM); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have used microSD cards, but nothing in my recent purchases establishes a need for this capacity or a compatible device.
ItemID: 6; Title: Blink Mini – Compact indoor plug-in smart security camera, 1080p HD video, night vision, motion detection, two-way audio, easy set up, Works with Alexa – 3 cameras (Black); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Three indoor cameras feel excessive for my current needs; entrance monitoring is more immediately useful.
ItemID: 7; Title: Echo Show 8 (2nd Gen, 2021 release) - Glacier White - with 30-day FREE trial of Alexa Together (monthly auto-renewal); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A larger Alexa display appeals, but I just bought a Show 5 and its stand, so I would postpone another display.
ItemID: 8; Title: Seagate BarraCuda 4TB Internal Hard Drive HDD – 3.5 Inch Sata 6 Gb/s 5400 RPM 256MB Cache For Computer Desktop PC – Frustration Free Packaging ST4000DMZ04/DM004; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My previous 4TB drive was external; I have no current desktop installation project requiring an internal HDD.
ItemID: 9; Title: Echo Dot (4th Gen) | Smart speaker with clock and Alexa | Twilight Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The clock is useful and the model fits my Alexa setup, but it substantially duplicates my recent Dot purchase.
ItemID: 10; Title: Blink Video Doorbell | Two-way audio, HD video, motion and chime app alerts, and Alexa enabled — wired or wire-free (White); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this as a practical extension of my Alexa devices and earlier door alarms, with entrance alerts and two-way communication.
